# MemInjectBytes

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Copies bytes into another space at a fixed address.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
Err MemInjectBytes(Handle kitten_space_handle, VirtAddr va, const void *src, size_t len, MemProt prot);
```

Creates a temporary memory object of whole pages, copies `len` bytes in, zero-fills the rest and injects it with MemInjectObj().

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kitten_space_handle` | in | Target space with PERM_CNTL. |
| `va` | in | Page-aligned address in the target space. |
| `src` | in | Bytes to copy. |
| `len` | in | Number of bytes. |
| `prot` | in | Protection of the target mapping. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error from CreateMem(), MemMap() or MemInjectObj().
